text: All coverage in Madagascar was taken with a **Generation 3 trekker** camera.
NOTE: While there are some [unusual vehicles](https://maps.app.goo.gl/h5Xb4zMRj5EXpNXw8) seen on some of the coverage, the camera and blur is still the same.
text_zh: 馬達加斯加的所有街景覆蓋都是用**第 3 代徒步拍攝**相機拍攝的。
注意：雖然某些覆蓋上可以看到一些[不尋常的載具](https://maps.app.goo.gl/h5Xb4zMRj5EXpNXw8)，但相機和模糊效果仍然是一樣的。

text: Several **boat trekkers** can be found throughout the country.
text_zh: 全國各地都可以找到幾台**船隻徒步拍攝**。

text: Most coverage features one or several people walking alongside the trekker. These people can be used both to recognise the country and to regionguess it.
text_zh: 大多數覆蓋的特色是有一人或多人走在徒步拍攝旁邊。這些人可以用來辨識國家以及進行區域猜測。

text: Madagascar has two official languages: **French** and [**Malagasy**](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Malagasy_language), which is written with the Latin alphabet and contains many long, multiple-syllable words.
NOTE: [English](https://maps.app.goo.gl/1GZYGSBw3AdKn7CF6) can still be found on some commercial signs.
text_zh: 馬達加斯加有兩種官方語言：**法語**與[**馬達加斯加語**](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Malagasy_language)，它是用拉丁字母書寫，並包含許多長音、多音節的單字。
注意：在某些商業招牌上仍然可以找到[英文](https://maps.app.goo.gl/1GZYGSBw3AdKn7CF6)。

text: The climate of Madagascar generally varies from extremely dry in the southern and central parts, to tropical in the [north](https://www.google.com/maps/@-13.7504015,48.4654968,2a,90y,187.83h,97.83t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1s7MPvv_lTBLtRL6D9c6PqPg!2e0!7i13312!8i6656).
text_zh: 馬達加斯加的氣候大致從南部和中部地區的極度乾燥，到[北部](https://www.google.com/maps/@-13.7504015,48.4654968,2a,90y,187.83h,97.83t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1s7MPvv_lTBLtRL6D9c6PqPg!2e0!7i13312!8i6656)的熱帶氣候不等。

text: Street View in Madagascar is very limited, with a mixture of land and boat coverage, most of which is on or near the west coast. It is worth noting that almost all the coverage was taken using trekkers, with only two exceptions, both of which have a visible, unique Street View car.

Because of the limited coverage, this guide will be structured differently than most other guides. It will be divided into two main sections: one for **land coverage** and one for **boat coverage**, which in turn is divided into subsections based on region.
text_zh: 馬達加斯加的街景服務非常有限，混合了陸地和船隻覆蓋，其中大部分在西海岸或其附近。值得注意的是，幾乎所有的覆蓋都是使用徒步拍攝拍攝的，只有兩個例外，這兩處都有明顯且獨特的街景車。
由於覆蓋有限，本指南的結構將與大多數其他指南不同。它將分為兩個主要部分：一個用於**陸地覆蓋**，另一個用於**船隻覆蓋**，船隻覆蓋又根據地區進一步細分為子部分。

text: The coverage in Ambanja can be recognized by a person wearing a **dark blue T-shirt** and black sunglasses.
text_zh: 安班加（Ambanja）的覆蓋可以透過一個穿著**深藍色 T 恤**和黑色太陽眼鏡的人來辨識。

text: The coverage on the island of Nosy Ambariovato can be recognized by the **people**, one wearing a blue T-shirt and sunglasses on their forehead, one with a light red T-shirt and one with a [darker red tank top](https://goo.gl/maps/sesxVH8xbgjzWWNt8). There is also a [fourth person](https://www.google.com/maps/@-13.4541161,48.3406304,2a,64.5y,249.26h,65.91t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1sx4Wu5e_usfrumoBchBeMCQ!2e0!7i13312!8i6656) in some of the coverage, wearing a light blue T-shirt. The coverage is very hilly and forested.
text_zh: 諾西昂巴里瓦托島（Nosy Ambariovato）上的覆蓋可以透過**人物**來辨識：一人穿著藍色 T 恤、額頭上戴著太陽眼鏡，一人穿著淺紅色 T 恤，另一人穿著[較深紅色的背心](https://goo.gl/maps/sesxVH8xbgjzWWNt8)。在某些覆蓋中還有[第四個人](https://www.google.com/maps/@-13.4541161,48.3406304,2a,64.5y,249.26h,65.91t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1sx4Wu5e_usfrumoBchBeMCQ!2e0!7i13312!8i6656)，穿著淺藍色 T 恤。該覆蓋地區多山且森林密布。

text: There is a **village** by the northern shore of Nosy Ambariovato.
text_zh: 諾西昂巴里瓦托島的北岸有一個**村莊**。

text: Ambiky can be recognized by the large number of **palms** combined with the **brown**, sandy dirt road. In most of the coverage, there is a person walking in front of the trekker with a grey T-shirt and a brown backpack.
text_zh: 安比基（Ambiky）可以透過大量的**棕櫚樹**結合**棕色**的沙質泥土路來辨識。在大多數覆蓋中，前方有一人走在徒步拍攝前面，背著灰色 T 恤和棕色背包。

text: A beach west of Ambiky can be recognized by the **low trees** combined with low mountains to the northwest.
text_zh: 安比基以西的海灘可以透過**矮樹**結合西北方的低矮山脈來辨識。

text: An area with coverage south of Ambiky can be recognized by the large, solitary **green bushes** combined with a very slight red tinge in the dirt. Certain parts of the coverage are [quite wet](https://www.google.com/maps/@-13.551823,48.4587811,2a,90y,113.31h,83.81t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1sQR4WivGckMydCDGxYmxMcQ!2e0!7i13312!8i6656).
text_zh: 安比基以南有覆蓋的地區可以透過大型、孤立的**綠色灌木**結合泥土中非常微弱的紅色調來辨識。覆蓋的某些部分[相當潮濕](https://www.google.com/maps/@-13.551823,48.4587811,2a,90y,113.31h,83.81t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1sQR4WivGckMydCDGxYmxMcQ!2e0!7i13312!8i6656)。

text: There are three major sections of coverage along the Sambirano river, most of which can be identified with the single person, wearing a **dark blue** T-shirt and **sunglasses** on their forehead. The same person is also present on Nosy Ambariovato.
text_zh: 桑比拉諾河（Sambirano river）沿岸有三個主要的覆蓋路段，其中大部分可以透過單獨一人來辨識，他穿著**深藍色** T 恤，**額頭上戴著太陽眼鏡**。同一個人也出現在諾西昂巴里瓦托島上。

text: A small section of the coverage by the Sambirano river has two **different people** present on the coverage; one with a red T-shirt and white cap, and one with a [spotted dress](https://goo.gl/maps/1r7p8QfDCBG2oBLG6).
text_zh: 桑比拉諾河畔的一小段覆蓋有兩個**不同的人**出現；一人穿著紅色 T 恤和白色帽子，另一人穿著[斑點洋裝](https://goo.gl/maps/1r7p8QfDCBG2oBLG6)。

text: A couple of atolls on the central west coast can be seen on Street View. The northernmost is the smallest, and is easily recognizable as it only consists of **sand** and you can always see from one shore to the other.
NOTE: Among the five atolls with land coverage, only the two furthest south appear on the map.
text_zh: 中西海岸的幾個環礁可以在街景中看到。最北邊的最小，很容易辨識，因為它只由**沙子**組成，你總是能從一個海岸看到另一個海岸。
注意：在五個有陸地覆蓋的環礁中，只有最南端的兩個會在地圖上顯示。

text: The other atolls can be recognized by their small size relative to other landmasses and the [**broad leaved palms**](https://goo.gl/maps/56HEtMgavgGcwsjV8) which is rarely found anywhere else in the country.
text_zh: 其他環礁可以透過它們相對於其他陸地較小的體積以及在國內其他地方罕見的[**寬葉棕櫚**](https://goo.gl/maps/56HEtMgavgGcwsjV8)來辨識。

text: Most of the coverage in Antananarivo was taken on the **side of a hill** looking out over the city, which leads up to the [Queen’s Palace](https://goo.gl/maps/xU94ThbrNVjncEE27), which can be seen near the top of the hill.
text_zh: 安塔那那利佛（Antananarivo）的大部分覆蓋都是在俯瞰城市的**山腰**上拍攝的，通往[女王宮](https://goo.gl/maps/xU94ThbrNVjncEE27)，可以在山頂附近看到。

text: The coverage on the RN8 between Andriamena and Marofandilia can easily be recognized by the large **silver roof rack** on the Street View car. The coverage is very dry and sandy.
text_zh: Andriamena 和 Marofandilia 之間的 RN8 公路上的覆蓋可以輕易透過街景車上大型的**銀色車頂行李架**來辨識。該覆蓋非常乾燥且多沙。

text: The trekker next to the RN8 can be recognized by its extreme dryness, combined with the **four people** wearing red, blue, grey and light blue respectively.
text_zh: RN8 旁的徒步拍攝可以透過其極度的乾燥，以及**四個人**（分別穿著紅、藍、灰和淺藍色）來辨識。

text: Baobab Avenue is easy to recognize by the extremely **broad trunked** baobab trees along the side of the road.
text_zh: 猴麵包樹大道（Baobab Avenue）很容易透過路旁極其**粗幹**的猴麵包樹來辨識。

text: Morondava is most easily recognized by the bald person wearing either a light green or a [light red](https://www.google.com/maps/@-20.2922811,44.2728557,2a,90y,38.6h,75.53t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1sdLo7gIsqBtj0LwG4gDh_PQ!2e0!7i13312!8i6656) striped shirt. It is also one of few towns where the trekker walks on a paved road.
text_zh: 穆龍達瓦（Morondava）最容易透過穿著淺綠色或[淺紅色](https://www.google.com/maps/@-20.2922811,44.2728557,2a,90y,38.6h,75.53t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1sdLo7gIsqBtj0LwG4gDh_PQ!2e0!7i13312!8i6656)條紋襯衫的光頭人士來辨識。這也是徒步拍攝行走在柏油路上的少數城鎮之一。

text: Morondava has a very **smooth sand beach**, with the ocean to the northwest. There are a large number of palms visible.
text_zh: 穆龍達瓦擁有非常**平滑的沙灘**，海洋在西北方。可以看到大量的棕櫚樹。

text: Belo Sur Mer can be recognized by the large number of palms combined with the blanket of **white sand **on the ground.
text_zh: 貝洛敘梅（Belo Sur Mer）可以透過大量的棕櫚樹結合地上覆蓋的**白沙**來辨識。

text: The beach outside Belo Sur Mer can be recognized by the somewhat **dirty sand** and the curved shoreline with the ocean to the northwest.
text_zh: 貝洛敘梅外的海灘可以透過稍微**髒的沙子**以及西北方有海洋的彎曲海岸線來辨識。

text: Kirindy Mitea National Park can be most easily recognized by having the **reddest soil** present on Street View in Madagascar.
text_zh: 基林迪米特阿國家公園（Kirindy Mitea National Park）最容易透過馬達加斯加街景中存在**最紅的土壤**來辨識。

text: A car with a barely visible **grey metal roof rack** can be seen by Manahy. There are some locations where the car is completely [blurred out](https://www.google.com/maps/@-20.8635885,43.9144054,2a,75y,201.67h,54.09t,3.83r/data=!3m7!1e1!3m5!1sPAQm9O3ZuaHG6QXKk1Yzfg!2e0!6shttps:%2F%2Fstreetviewpixels-pa.googleapis.com%2Fv1%2Fthumbnail%3Fpanoid%3DPAQm9O3ZuaHG6QXKk1Yzfg%26cb_client%3Dmaps_sv.tactile.gps%26w%3D203%26h%3D100%26yaw%3D280%26pitch%3D0%26thumbfov%3D100!7i13312!8i6656), where the shape of the blur is the best indication of the area.
text_zh: 在馬納希（Manahy）附近可以看到一輛車頂行李架幾乎看不見的**灰色金屬車頂行李架**的汽車。有些地方車子被完全[模糊處理](https://www.google.com/maps/@-20.8635885,43.9144054,2a,75y,201.67h,54.09t,3.83r/data=!3m7!1e1!3m5!1sPAQm9O3ZuaHG6QXKk1Yzfg!2e0!6shttps:%2F%2Fstreetviewpixels-pa.googleapis.com%2Fv1%2Fthumbnail%3Fpanoid%3DPAQm9O3ZuaHG6QXKk1Yzfg%26cb_client%3Dmaps_sv.tactile.gps%26w%3D203%26h%3D100%26yaw%3D280%26pitch%3D0%26thumbfov%3D100!7i13312!8i6656)，此時模糊的形狀是該地區的最佳指示。

text: A piece of coverage, partly taken on a large [**grassy field**](https://goo.gl/maps/eCF98cDJ2mMTrNHV9), and partly on the side of a **sand dune**, can be found south of Manahy.
text_zh: 一部分覆蓋部分拍攝於大型[**草地**](https://goo.gl/maps/eCF98cDJ2mMTrNHV9)，部分拍攝於**沙丘**側邊，可以在馬納希以南找到。

text: A village with the shore to the **east** can be found north of Andavadoaka.
text_zh: 一個海岸朝向**東方**的村莊可以在安達瓦多卡（Andavadoaka）以北找到。

text: A small, very sandy village with the shore to the **north** can be seen on a small cape north of Andavadoaka. Part of the coverage was taken [just outside the shoreline](https://goo.gl/maps/Qn4qB1PmUcaRey337).
text_zh: 一個小而非常多沙、海岸朝向**北方**的村莊可以在安達瓦多卡以北的小海角上看到。部分覆蓋是在[海岸線外側](https://goo.gl/maps/Qn4qB1PmUcaRey337)拍攝的。

text: The town of Andavadoaka can be recognized by **three** different people appearing on the coverage; One wearing a greyish hat and a light blue shirt, and two with [red and white T-shirts](https://goo.gl/maps/bqLC2F1PQDcKc1jA7).
text_zh: 安達瓦多卡鎮可以透過覆蓋中出現的**三種**不同人物來辨識；一人戴著灰灰色帽子和淺藍色襯衫，兩人穿著[紅白色 T 恤](https://goo.gl/maps/bqLC2F1PQDcKc1jA7)。

text: The main part of the trekker coverage surrounding Andavadoaka can be recognized by either the person wearing a greyish hat and light blue shirt or a person wearing a** **[yellow T-shirt](https://goo.gl/maps/tk4eKhBmyttFugDG9).
text_zh: 環繞安達瓦多卡的徒步拍攝主要部分可以透過戴著灰灰色帽子和淺藍色襯衫的人，或是穿著[**黃色** T 恤](https://goo.gl/maps/tk4eKhBmyttFugDG9)的人來辨識。

text: A second Trekker, going to the northeast of Andavadoaka can be recognized by a person with a **light blue T-shirt**.
text_zh: 另一輛徒步拍攝前往安達瓦多阿卡（Andavadoaka）東北方時，可以透過一位穿著**淺藍色 T 恤**的人來辨識。

text: A blue cart dragged by a **black **cow on the left and a **brown-white **cow on the right can be found south of Andavadoaka.
text_zh: 一輛由左側**黑色**牛與右側**棕白相間**牛拉著的藍色手推車，可以在安達瓦多aka南方找到。

text: Another cart dragged by a **white** cow on the left and a **black and white cow** on the right can be found just south of Andavadoaka.
text_zh: 另一輛由左側**白色**牛與右側**黑白相間的牛**拉著的手推車，就在安達瓦多aka南方可以找到。

text: A small seaside village, with little to **no visible people** can be found in the northern end of the bay, south of Andavadoaka.
text_zh: 一個幾乎**看不到任何人**的小型海濱村莊，位於安達瓦多aka南方海灣的北端。

text: Coverage on a somewhat **rocky** ground with **no people** following the trekker can be found southwest of the bay.
text_zh: 在帶有**岩石**地面的街景覆蓋中，且**沒有人**跟著徒步拍攝，位於海灣的西南方。

text: Coverage with multiple different people walking near and around the trekker, and with a [small village](https://www.google.com/maps/@-22.2385629,43.2972032,2a,90y,125.63h,91.6t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1s3dMI1dhBOWDorIiI3h7DrQ!2e0!7i13312!8i6656) to the west, can be found in the southeastern part of the bay. Part of the coverage goes through a very [shallow body of water](https://maps.app.goo.gl/rZReKRbq4E5qccdeA).
text_zh: 帶有多位不同的人在徒步拍攝附近及周圍走動的街景覆蓋，且西方有一個[小村莊](https://www.google.com/maps/@-22.2385629,43.2972032,2a,90y,125.63h,91.6t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1s3dMI1dhBOWDorIiI3h7DrQ!2e0!7i13312!8i6656)，可以在海灣的東南部找到。部分街景覆蓋會穿過一處非常[淺的水域](https://maps.app.goo.gl/rZReKRbq4E5qccdeA)。

text: A cluster of **fishing nets** can be found in the bay.
text_zh: 海灣中可以找到一叢**漁網**。

text: The Tsaranoro Massif is a large [**monolithic mountain**](https://goo.gl/maps/coxbSnD6beVYspY19) with trekker coverage. The steep mountainsides, combined with the mountainous area surrounding the coverage makes it very recognizable. The [four people](https://www.google.com/maps/@-22.0973126,46.7594034,2a,90y,182.36h,90.99t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1s0NR1H26JY_5a9JRRVRluDw!2e0!7i13312!8i6656) following the trekker can also occasionally be a useful clue.
text_zh: 查拉諾羅山塊（Tsaranoro Massif）是一座大型[**巨石山**](https://goo.gl/maps/coxbSnD6beVYspY19)，具備徒步拍攝街景覆蓋。陡峭的山壁，加上環繞街景覆蓋的山區使其非常好認。跟著徒步拍攝的[四個人](https://www.google.com/maps/@-22.0973126,46.7594034,2a,90y,182.36h,90.99t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1s0NR1H26JY_5a9JRRVRluDw!2e0!7i13312!8i6656)有時也是一個有用的線索。

text: A small part of the coverage in Tsaranoro was taken inside a forest, which occasionally hides the surrounding mountains. The best way to recognize this area is the relatively **dark coverage**, combined with the four people following the trekker.
text_zh: 查拉諾羅的一小部分街景覆蓋是在森林內部拍攝的，這偶爾會遮蔽周圍的山脈。辨識這個區域的最佳方式是相對**昏暗的街景覆蓋**，結合跟著徒步拍攝的四個人。

text: A **small settlement** is found in the northeastern end of Tsaranoro. The mountains can typically be seen in the background.
text_zh: 查拉諾羅東北端有一個**小型聚落**。背景通常可以看到群山。

text: Toliara can be recognized as being a generally quite busy-looking town and the only large town on Madagascar with **no person** following the trekker.
text_zh: 圖利亞拉（Toliara）可以透過整體看起來相當繁忙的城鎮來辨識，且它是馬達加斯加唯一一個**沒有人**跟著徒步拍攝的大城鎮。

text: Two pieces of coverage can be recognized by two people following the trekker; one with a **yellow tank top** and one with a **blue T-shirt**. The first of these two parts is located in the town of St Augustin.
text_zh: 有兩段街景覆蓋可以透過跟著徒步拍攝的兩個人來辨識；一人穿著**黃色背心**，另一人穿著**藍色 T 恤**。這兩部分的第一段位於聖奧古斯丁（St Augustin）鎮。

text: The second part with the same two people is found to the east of St Augustin, going through a **hilly landscape** with a lot of shrubs.
text_zh: 第二段有著同樣兩個人，位在 St Augustin 東側，會穿過一片有許多灌木的**起伏山丘景觀**。

text: A white boat, containing **many people**, can be found going around the island of Nosy Ambariovato.
text_zh: 有一艘白色的船，載著**許多人**，可以在 Nosy Ambariovato 島的周遭找到。

text: A mainly **blue boat** can be found along the coast south of Nosy Ambariovato.
text_zh: 一艘主要是**藍色的船**可以在 Nosy Ambariovato 南側的海岸沿線找到。

text: A row boat containing five people with a **wide wooden frame **surrounding it can be found northwest of Ambohimena.
text_zh: 一艘載著五個人、周圍帶有**寬大木架**的划艇可以在 Ambohimena 西北側找到。

text: A boat going up the Sambirano River can be seen with **two people**; a tourist with a blue T-shirt and a gondolier with a brown shirt. The northernmost part of the coverage is [very dark](https://goo.gl/maps/nzQX5CgEam31fFrbA), as it was taken during sunset.
text_zh: 有一艘行駛在 Sambirano River 上的船可以看到有**兩個人**；一位是穿著藍色 T 恤的遊客，另一位是穿著棕色襯衫的船夫。街景最北端的部分[非常昏暗](https://goo.gl/maps/nzQX5CgEam31fFrbA)，因為這是日落時拍攝的。

text: The boat covering some small atolls along the central parts of the west coast can be recognized by the driver, wearing a **white cap** and **no shirt**.
text_zh: 這艘拍攝西海岸中部一帶小型環礁的船可以透過駕駛來辨識，他戴著**白色帽子**且**打赤膊**。

text: The boat north of Andavadoaka can mostly be recognized by the **large sail** almost filling up the entire screen and the [bow](https://www.google.com/maps/@-21.9535228,43.2636268,2a,55.4y,36.5h,61.5t,0.68r/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1shdQMOTBRSEXz7sS9LL0q7w!2e0!7i13312!8i6656) which is painted yellow and blue. Note that the sail is not present in the northern parts of the coverage.
text_zh: 在 Andavadoaka 北側的船主要可以透過幾乎佔滿整個畫面的**大風帆**來辨識，其[船首](https://www.google.com/maps/@-21.9535228,43.2636268,2a,55.4y,36.5h,61.5t,0.68r/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1shdQMOTBRSEXz7sS9LL0q7w!2e0!7i13312!8i6656)漆成黃色和藍色。請注意，風帆在街景較北處並不存在。

text: The boat in the bay south of Andavadoaka can be recognized by either the somewhat **smaller sail** than the one north of Andavadoaka, or the person sitting by the bow wearing a [**red T-shirt**](https://www.google.com/maps/@-22.2352535,43.2975109,2a,66.6y,25.5h,81.08t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1sNRpIPDMqSBxlPqXDBZW6WQ!2e0!7i13312!8i6656) with the text “Diesel”. Beware that only one of the two will appear on most of the coverage.
text_zh: 在 Andavadoaka 南側海灣的船可以透過比 Andavadoaka 北側稍**小的風帆**來辨識，或者透過坐在船首、穿著印有「Diesel」字樣[**紅色 T 恤**](https://www.google.com/maps/@-22.2352535,43.2975109,2a,66.6y,25.5h,81.08t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1sNRpIPDMqSBxlPqXDBZW6WQ!2e0!7i13312!8i6656)的人來辨識。請注意，在大部分的街景中，這兩者通常只會出現一個。

text: Four people; one dressed in **red**, one in **blue** and one in** yellow **in the back, and one dressed in brown at the front, can be seen on a boat by the town of St Augustin.
text_zh: 有四個人；後方一個穿著**紅色**、一個穿著**藍色**、一個穿著**黃色**，前方一個穿著棕色，可以在 St Augustin 小鎮旁的船上看到。
